notes.title: Ver1.0.2のアップデート
notes.notes:
Ver1.0.2の変更
・エンディング分岐の難易度を上方修正（なお、エンディング分岐はノベルパートの選択肢及びバグ発見数に依存します）
・ブラックホールスキル使用時に特定の条件でフリーズするバグを修正
・コントローラー接続時に一部操作やUIが正しく表記されないバグを修正
・実績解除が一部正しく反映されていないバグを修正
・誤字、文字化け部分を一部修正

notes.title: Ver1.0.1のアップデートに関して
notes.notes:

Fixed: Mode bug fixes
Fixed: problem with stage rendering.
Fixed: Freeze problem when falling into an abyss at a certain point.
Fixed: Bug in the map gimmick.

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello.
Steam "Debug Girl" is now available for purchase on May 30, 2024.
If you are considering purchasing the game, you can get 10% off until June 13 as a launch discount!

We hope you enjoy the story with the main character, Eguchi-kun, and Kurumi Sakura, a fan of the game he created. And don't forget to check out the bug discovery in the game that Eguchi-kun has unintentionally (?) planted in the game. It may be difficult to find bugs in the game that Eguchi-kun has planted, but please try your best to find all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739625/8fb295eb9260452d1a9f4eba5f927794079ee94f.jpg[/img]
We have also received some reports of problems (real ones) in the game.
We are currently working on fixing them, so please apply the update each time you see it.

So, Thank you for your continued support of "Debug Girl"!

notes.title: Released on May 30!
notes.notes:
Hello,
The release date for "Debug Girl" has been set for May 30!
The indie game development story with heroine Kurumi starts next Thursday.

[previewyoutube=wRcnMzzUFMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Debug Girl has gone gold!
notes.notes:
Hello,
We are happy to announce the completion of "Debug Girl"!

[previewyoutube=45mY7VfgDLE;full][/previewyoutube]
Please create a game together with the heroine, Kurumi Sakura, and exhibit your game at an indie game event as the last memory from your summer vacation! The game is available in English and Chinese as well as Japanese. Keyboard operation is supported, but we recommend using a game controller.

We expect to be able to provide a release date and price shortly.
Please look forward to it.
